findings.issue: `mul_weightMap`, `mul_coweightMap`, `mul_indexEquiv`, `mul_exponent`, `one_weightMap`, `one_coweightMap`, `one_indexEquiv`, `one_exponent`, `pow_weightMap`, `pow_coweightMap`, `pow_indexEquiv`, `pow_exponent` (lines 523–587) put the monoid operation before the projection. summary: The twelve new monoid/iterate projection lemmas are named operation-first (`mul_weightMap`, `one_exponent`, `pow_indexEquiv`, …), inverting the projection-first order Mathlib uses for the identical API on `RootPairing.Hom` (`weightMap_mul`, `weightMap_one`, `indexEquiv_mul`). Everything else — `mul_def`/`one_def`, `pow_exponent`'s statement-vs-name strength, and the `*SpecialIsogeny_mul_self` renames — is fine.
